entries.zh: 相會；聚在一起，結為同夥。
entries.en: to meet together; to join in company with one another.

entries.zh: 大家一起商議；共同斟酌、共同謀議。
entries.en: to take counsel together; to deliberate jointly (Sp. concertarse unos con otros).
entries.notes: L 栏在「u」后残缺，据 H「大家思量」与 M/R 补足为「共同商议」。

entries.zh: 定價；開價、議定價錢。
entries.en: to set a price; to fix or agree on the price.

entries.zh: 串通為惡；共謀做壞事。
entries.en: to conspire together for evil; to plot mischief jointly.
entries.notes: M 栏并列两读（套谋／套局），R 栏与 H「套謀」对音不合，取 H 与 L 相合之义。

entries.zh: 思量；反覆盤算、斟酌。
entries.en: to deliberate; to weigh over in mind.

entries.zh: 設局；串通設下圈套害人。
entries.en: to set a trap together; to conspire to do harm.

entries.zh: 通同；串通一氣、私下勾結。
entries.en: to be in collusion; to act in league with someone.
entries.notes: L 栏「de sege en」之后残缺、语义不明，释义依 H「通同」与 M/R。

entries.zh: （買賣雙方）議定價錢、抹平講定。
entries.en: to settle a price between the parties (lit. to smear, smooth over); to strike a bargain.
entries.notes: H/M 均作「塗抹」（塗擦、抹去），与 L「双方议价」须靠「抹平」一义衔接，故降置信。

entries.zh: 私下議論、背地批評（上司）；私評。
entries.en: to criticize privately; to speak ill of one's superior behind his back.

entries.zh: 謀害；共謀陷害、圖謀不軌。
entries.en: to conspire to do harm; to plot injury or treason against someone.

entries.zh: 相通同；彼此串通，合謀行騙。
entries.en: to collude in order to deceive; to gang up to cheat.

entries.zh: 處常；安於常態、依習慣本能行事而合度。
entries.en: settled and well-ordered by habit or instinct; keeping to the ordinary course.
entries.notes: L「Concertado, instinto」与 H「處常」（處置日常、安於常）仅大意可通，对应关系存疑。

entries.zh: 齊入；次序井然、舉止審慎（字面与 circumspecto 对应存疑）。
entries.en: orderly, circumspect; entering in due order (the Chinese gloss is uncertain).
entries.notes: H「齊入」字面不作「謹慎」解，M/R 仅为音读对音，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 樸實；誠樸老實、品行端正。
entries.en: plain and honest; upright, virtuous.

entries.zh: 斡旋；居中調停、替人講定（對象為粗人或下層人）。
entries.en: to mediate; to arrange a matter for a crude fellow (chabacano).
entries.notes: H 栏自标「疑」，且 17 世纪马尼拉 chabacano 亦可指混血／华人土语使用者，此处取「粗鄙之人」义。

entries.zh: 華美；華麗精緻、艷麗奪目。
entries.en: handsome, elegant; ornate and showy.

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕concha＝貝殼、海螺；本条疑为指向后文的参见条，汉字与音写栏皆空缺。
entries.en: shell, seashell — 〔original blank, gloss uncertain〕; apparently a cross-reference entry ("see below").
entries.notes: H/M/R 三栏全空，仅存 L「Concha. g. infra.」，无汉字可证。

entries.zh: 交關了；交易講定、買賣已議成（交關指交易往來）。
entries.en: a settled bargain; a deal concluded (the Chinese means dealings brought to a close).

entries.zh: 交結明白；把交易或約定講得清清楚楚。
entries.en: bargains clearly agreed; an explicit, open agreement.
entries.notes: R 栏末字作 pē，与 H「白」对音不合，末字暂依 H。

entries.zh: 交結；訂交、結約。
entries.en: to strike a firm agreement; to bind oneself by agreement.

entries.zh: 攬定；承攬下來講定、把事情敲定。
entries.en: to take on and settle firmly; a concluded undertaking.

entries.zh: 死結；解不開的約定、鐵定的契約（不可翻悔）。
entries.en: a dead knot; an irrevocable agreement that cannot be undone.
entries.notes: L 作 rebocable（可撤销），而 H/M 皆作「死結」即不可解，疑 L 脱 irre- 前缀，义从 H。
